name: linux-hardware-issues
title: Hardware Issues
description: Problem devices, disk health, battery, memory and hardware error events

checks.title: Block devices and SMART health
command: for d in $(lsblk -dn -o NAME,TYPE 2>/dev/null | awk '$2=="disk"{print "/dev/"$1}'); do
echo "--- $d"; smartctl -H "$d" 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'overall-health|SMART Health|Permission denied' || echo "smartctl needs root for $d"
echo "smartctl not installed (apt install smartmontools) - SMART not checked"

checks.title: Battery condition
command: for b in $(upower -e 2>/dev/null | grep -i bat); do upower -i "$b" | grep -E 'state|percentage|energy-full|energy-full-design|capacity|cycle'; done
for b in /sys/class/power_supply/BAT*; do [ -d "$b" ] && { echo "$b"; cat "$b/status" "$b/capacity" "$b/cycle_count" 2>/dev/null; }; done
